description: LLM Critic rubric for Azure Key Vault operations

checks: Key Vault provisioningState is Succeeded or Failed
vaultUri and tenantId are present for a successfully created vault
SKU (Standard/Premium) matches the requested tier
Soft-delete and purge protection settings match the requested configuration
Delete Key Vault operations include pre-confirmation show command
No credential or secret values in stdout/stderr (only references)
Key Vault purge operations warn about permanent data loss
Access policy changes verify principal ID and permission set before applying
Re-running the same command produces consistent output
Secret/key create operations check for existing names and version appropriately
Access policy updates merge rather than replace existing policies
Delete operations on soft-deleted vaults check recovery context
Command, exit_code, stdout, and stderr are all captured
Timestamp and iteration count are recorded
Access policy assignments (principal, permissions) are documented
Key/secret metadata (expiry, enabled, contentType) is logged
All commands include --output json flag
Resource group is specified with --resource-group
Vault name is globally unique (check for existing)
RBAC vs access-policy mode is explicitly selected for vault creation
